title: Chat Server's Outgoing Traffic
titleZh: 聊天服务器的出站流量
statementMd:
Polycarp is working on a new project called "Polychat". Following modern tendencies in IT, he decided, that this project should contain chat as well. To achieve this goal, Polycarp has spent several hours in front of his laptop and implemented a chat server that can process three types of commands:

- Include a person to the chat (`'Add'` command).
- Remove a person from the chat (`'Remove'` command).
- Send a message from a person to all people, who are currently in the chat, including the one, who sends the message (`'Send'` command).

Now Polycarp wants to find out the amount of outgoing traffic that the server will produce while processing a particular set of commands.

Polycarp knows that chat server sends no traffic for 'Add' and 'Remove' commands. When 'Send' command is processed, server sends $*l*$ bytes to each participant of the chat, where $*l*$ is the length of the message.

As Polycarp has no time, he is asking for your help in solving this problem.

## Input

Input file will contain not more than 100 commands, each in its own line. No line will exceed 100 characters. Formats of the commands will be the following:

- `+<name>` for `'Add'` command.
- `-<name>` for `'Remove'` command.
- `<sender_name>:<message_text>` for `'Send'` command.

`<name>` and `<sender_name>` is a non-empty sequence of Latin letters and digits. `<message_text>` can contain letters, digits and spaces, but can't start or end with a space. `<message_text>` can be an empty line.

It is guaranteed, that input data are correct, i.e. there will be no `'Add'` command if person with such a name is already in the chat, there will be no `'Remove'` command if there is no person with such a name in the chat etc.

All names are case-sensitive.

## Output

Print a single number — answer to the problem.
statementZhMd:
Polycarp 正在开发一个名为“Polychat”的新项目。顺应 IT 领域的现代趋势，他决定在项目中加入聊天功能。为了实现这一目标，Polycarp 花了几个小时坐在笔记本电脑前，实现了一个可以处理以下三种命令的聊天服务器：

- 将一个人加入聊天（`'Add'` 命令）。
- 将一个人从聊天中移除（`'Remove'` 命令）。
- 让一个人向当前聊天中的所有人发送消息，包括发送消息的人自己（`'Send'` 命令）。

现在，Polycarp 想知道服务器在处理给定的一组命令时会产生多少出站流量。

Polycarp 知道，服务器在处理 `'Add'` 和 `'Remove'` 命令时不会产生流量。当处理 `'Send'` 命令时，服务器会向聊天中的每位参与者发送 $*l*$ 字节，其中 $*l*$ 是消息的长度。

由于 Polycarp 没有时间，他请求你帮助解决这个问题。

## 输入格式

输入文件中包含不超过 100 条命令，每条命令占一行。每行长度不超过 100 个字符。命令的格式如下：

- `'Add'` 命令的格式为 `+<name>`。
- `'Remove'` 命令的格式为 `-<name>`。
- `'Send'` 命令的格式为 `<sender_name>:<message_text>`。

`<name>` 和 `<sender_name>` 是由拉丁字母和数字组成的非空序列。`<message_text>` 可以包含字母、数字和空格，但不能以空格开头或结尾。`<message_text>` 可以为空。

保证输入数据正确，即如果聊天中已经有某个名字的人，就不会出现将其加入聊天的 `'Add'` 命令；如果聊天中没有某个名字的人，就不会出现将其移除的 `'Remove'` 命令，等等。

所有名字都区分大小写。

## 输出格式

输出一个数字——问题的答案。
